definitions.explanation: The time in September when day and night are approximately equal in length, marking the midpoint of autumn.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The autumnal equinox is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the autumnal equinox, the days get shorter.

examples.japanese: {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧9⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧22⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧23⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The autumnal equinox falls around September 22nd or 23rd every year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn) and ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (division, equinox). Refers to the astronomical event when the sun crosses the celestial equator heading south.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ} (Autumnal Equinox Day) is a national holiday in Japan. It falls during ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ (the autumn equinox week), when people visit family graves, clean them, and offer ⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧ (rice balls coated in sweet bean paste).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋分|しゅうぶん}の{日|ひ} — Autumnal Equinox Day (national holiday)
- {秋分|しゅうぶん}{点|てん} — autumnal equinox point (astronomical term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{春分|しゅんぶん}→春分：19942_shunbun⟧ — vernal equinox; the spring counterpart
- ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ — equinox week; the Buddhist observance period around each equinox
